A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served as a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Sometime before [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> he encountered the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Praven]], and the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] took offense to what he saw as a lack of respect on the [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] part. As punishment, Praven [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|choked]] the major with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], breaking the man's neck after forcing an apology out of him.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial major was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', though the guide did not specify the male's name or [[Species/Legends|species]].
